canDoYue: 你識喺電話問珠寶存貨，仲識預留同聽日嚟取。
canDoEn: Ask about jewellery stock on the phone, then reserve a piece and collect it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning. This is the jewellery shop.
dialogue.say: Good morning. This is the jewellery shop.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Do you still have a similar gold bracelet, and can I reserve one today?
dialogue.glossYue: 你仲有冇類似嘅金手鏈，今日可唔可以預留一條？
dialogue.say: Do you still have a similar gold bracelet, and can I reserve one today?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I'll describe the similar gold bracelet we have.
dialogue.glossYue: 我描述吓我哋有嘅類似金手鏈。
dialogue.say: I'll describe the similar gold bracelet we have.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Text me when it's ready. What are your opening hours?
dialogue.glossYue: 貨準備好就發短訊話我知。你哋幾點開門？
dialogue.say: Text me when it's ready. What are your opening hours?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I'm calling to ask about stock, and I'll collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.
dialogue.glossYue: 我打嚟問存貨，你確認之後我聽日嚟取條手鏈。
dialogue.say: I'm calling to ask about stock, and I'll collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.
dialogue.glossYue: 舖頭時間貼喺門上面，地址就喺呢條街、街市旁邊。
dialogue.say: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以預留一件類似嘅金飾，用 Mei 個名留住？
dialogue.say: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I'll text you when it's ready. You can collect it tomorrow.
dialogue.glossYue: 準備好我會發短訊畀你。你聽日可以嚟攞。
dialogue.say: I'll text you when it's ready. You can collect it tomorrow.
